clue.text: Temple of Apollo, perhaps, in Pennsylvania

indicators.note: in places the Apollo phrase inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: PA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Pennsylvania
Apollo is an example of a god, so 'a god' with the article kept

explanation.surface: A guidebook note about a shrine to Apollo found somewhere in Pennsylvania.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts A GOD inside PA, splitting it P...A.
explanation.definitionFit: A pagoda is a tiered tower serving as a Buddhist or Hindu shrine, a kind of temple.

clue.text: Bully loses head, wearing friend's medallion

indicators.note: wearing means the friend has the trimmed bully on, wrapped around it

parts.note: a pal is a friend

indicators.note: loses head means the bully word drops its first letter

parts.note: to hector is to bully

explanation.surface: A bully is beheaded while sporting a friend's medal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses head' cuts HECTOR to ECTOR, and 'wearing' has PAL around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A pectoral is an ornament worn on the chest, such as a large medallion or cross.

clue.text: Brilliance of a dog's last group of offspring

indicators.note: last means the final letter of the word dog

parts.note: a litter is a brood of young born at once

explanation.surface: The sparkle of a dog's final litter of puppies.
explanation.definitionFit: Glitter is sparkle or showy brightness, a kind of brilliance.

clue.text: It takes seconds, oddly enough, to clothe each minister

indicators.note: to clothe means the rearranged letters dress, or surround, the abbreviation for each
oddly enough means the letters of seconds are set in an odd new order

explanation.surface: Dressing each clergyman takes only seconds, curiously.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly enough' rearranges SECONDS into DCONESS, and 'to clothe' wraps it around EA, after D. 'It takes' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A deaconess is a woman serving in a church's ministry, a minister of religion.

clue.text: The twelfth foundation stone — it's a revelation!

definitions.text: The twelfth foundation stone — it's a revelation!

parts.words: The twelfth foundation stone — it's a revelation!
parts.note: the Book of Revelation lists twelve gems as the foundations of the New Jerusalem's wall, and the twelfth is a purple quartz

explanation.surface: An excited archaeologist unearths the final cornerstone of a building and is amazed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revelation' looks like a surprise; it points to the Book of Revelation, chapter 21, where the twelfth foundation is this purple gem.
explanation.definitionFit: Revelation 21:20 names this violet quartz as the twelfth foundation stone of the holy city.

clue.text: Underhand dealings acceptable, note, in male company

indicators.note: in puts the acceptable and note words inside the male company

parts.note: a business is a company
on means acceptable, as in 'that's not on'
a key is a musical note or pitch

explanation.surface: Shady deals are fine, someone notes, in all-male firms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts ON + KEY after M at the front of BUSINESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Mischief or trickery is the sense of this idiom, covering shady or dishonest dealings.

clue.text: Worn by a Persian king, it upset a sun god

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the word it is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: Ra is the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: A Persian monarch's headgear knocks over the sun god's statue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns IT into TI, then A and RA follow.
explanation.definitionFit: The tiara was originally the tall headdress of ancient Persian kings, worn as a sign of royalty.

clue.text: Jazz fan in any university out in Central America

indicators.note: in places the jazz fan inside the rearranged letters
out means the letters of any plus U are put out of order

parts.note: a cat is old slang for a jazz enthusiast

explanation.surface: A jazz lover at any college is away on a trip to Central America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges ANY + U into YUAN, and 'in' puts CAT inside it after YU.
explanation.definitionFit: The Yucatán peninsula lies in Mexico and Central America, a region named by the definition loosely.

clue.text: Most of the 24, though without one hair on the head

indicators.note: most of means the word the loses its final letter
without means the answer to clue 24 goes without the letter for one

parts.note: clue 24 Down's answer is the name of the letter H
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A cryptic instruction pointing at a cross-referenced clue to find a thick head of hair.
explanation.walkthrough: '24' is a cross-reference to 24 Down. 'Most of' cuts THE to TH, and 'without' drops I from that answer. 'though' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Thatch is informal for a thick mop of hair on someone's head, likened to a straw roof.

clue.text: Soften up chap with curly hair at first, writing this

indicators.note: at first means the chap with curly hair comes before the soften word in the answer

parts.note: cove is old British slang for a chap or man
a ringlet is a curl of hair

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the soften word is read bottom to top

parts.note: to ret is to soak flax or hemp to soften it

explanation.surface: A job applicant sends a softening-up letter with a curly-haired man in mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns RET into TER, and 'at first' puts COVE + RINGLET before it. The definition, 'writing this', points back: what you write to soften up the reader.
explanation.definitionFit: A letter sent with an application or document to introduce it is meant to win over the reader.

clue.text: Talk now broadcast about popular foreign enclave

indicators.note: about means the scrambled letters sit around the word for popular

parts.note: talk means chat

indicators.note: broadcast as in seed scattered widely, so the letters of the talk word plus now are spread and rearranged

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable

explanation.surface: A radio talk show goes out live discussing a popular neighbourhood of foreigners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges CHAT and NOW into CHATOWN, and 'about' puts it around IN, after the CH.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chinese quarter of a Western city is a district where an immigrant community lives apart, an enclave.

clue.text: Part of circle an accountant rebuffed in Ghana

indicators.note: rebuffed means pushed back, so the arc and the accountant are read backwards together

parts.note: an arc is part of a circle's circumference
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: An accountant is snubbed and left out of some social circle in West Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rebuffed' turns ARC + CA backwards to give the city. The definition is 'in Ghana', meaning a place in that country.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Ghana lies on its Atlantic coast, so it is a place in that country.

clue.text: Not in firm state as a consequence

parts.note: not in, as of a player or someone away from home, means out
CO is short for company, a firm
ME is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Maine

explanation.surface: Someone excluded from a company finds themselves in that position as a result.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcome is a result, what follows from something as its consequence.

clue.text: Only remaining one in the city, variable according to price

indicators.note: in puts the remaining word and one inside the abbreviation for the City

parts.note: EC is the postcode district of the City of London, the financial centre
the only one remaining is the last
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: The sole surviving shop in the City charges whatever prices the market will bear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts LAST + I inside EC. Economists call demand that rises or falls with price elastic.
explanation.definitionFit: In economics, demand that changes markedly as the price changes is described as stretchy in this technical sense.

clue.text: Consent to a European king being removed

indicators.note: being removed means the king's letter is taken out of the European

parts.note: a Greek is a European
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A deposed European monarch accepts his fate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being removed' takes K out of GREEK, leaving GREE after A.
explanation.definitionFit: To agree to something is to accept it, give one's consent to it.

clue.text: Taking in exchange big mini with black interior

indicators.note: interior means the black letter goes inside the rearranged words
exchange means the letters of big and mini swap places among themselves

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Someone is accepting a small Mini, black inside, as a trade-in for a bigger car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchange' rearranges BIG MINI into IMIBING, and 'interior' puts B inside it, after IM. 'Taking in' is the definition, not a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Imbibing means drinking or absorbing, taking something in.

clue.text: Uncompromising about new pier plan

indicators.note: about means the uncompromising word goes around the rearranged pier

parts.note: blunt means uncompromising, frank

indicators.note: new means the letters of pier are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: An uncompromising critic attacks a plan for a new pier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges PIER into EPRI, and 'about' puts BLUNT around it, after BLU.
explanation.definitionFit: A blueprint is a detailed technical drawing, hence any plan or design.

clue.text: Lacking 24, he slew any converted Christian

indicators.note: converted means the letters of he slew any are changed into a new form

parts.note: clue 24 Down's answer is the name of the letter H

explanation.surface: A man who killed someone converts to Christianity.
explanation.walkthrough: '24' points to 24 Down, the letter H. 'Lacking' removes an H from HESLEWANY, and 'converted' rearranges what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: A Methodist, a follower of John Wesley's movement, is a Christian.

clue.text: Planet has source of 2 inside — it's mostly methane

parts.note: Mars is a planet

indicators.note: inside means the source letter of clue 2's answer goes within the word has
source of means the first letter of the answer to clue 2

explanation.surface: A planet holds something from clue 2 within it, and its atmosphere is mainly methane.
explanation.walkthrough: '2' is a cross-reference to 2 Down; 'source of' takes its first letter, G, and 'inside' puts it in HAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Gas rising from rotting vegetation in wetlands consists chiefly of methane.

clue.text: Where Montgomery grew up, to the south of Birmingham

definitions.text: Where Montgomery grew up, to the south of Birmingham

parts.words: Where Montgomery grew up, to the south of Birmingham
parts.note: Montgomery suggests the British field marshal and Birmingham the English city, but both are cities in a US southern state, Montgomery its capital lying south of Birmingham

explanation.surface: A biographical note on where a famous general spent his childhood, south of an English city.
explanation.walkthrough: Montgomery and Birmingham seem British; both are cities in the US state, Montgomery to the south of Birmingham, and 'grew up' hints that it grew into the state capital.
explanation.definitionFit: This US Deep South state contains both Montgomery, its capital, and Birmingham, its largest city.

clue.text: Edict Kashmir's leaders put into practice

indicators.note: put into means Kashmir's first letters go inside the practice word

parts.note: use means practice, as in custom

indicators.note: leaders means the leading letters of Kashmir

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: An order issued by the rulers of Kashmir is enforced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaders' takes KA from Kashmir, and 'put into' puts it inside USE.
explanation.definitionFit: A ukase was a decree of the Russian tsar, so any arbitrary edict or order.

clue.text: A girl model, on the plump side

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, short for Diana
to pose is to model

explanation.surface: A girl who works as a model is a little overweight.
explanation.definitionFit: Adipose means fatty, of body fat, which suits one somewhat plump.

clue.text: Tommy has to follow retriever, perhaps

parts.note: a Tommy gun is the Thompson submachine gun
to dog is to follow closely

explanation.surface: A British soldier has to trail behind his retriever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tommy' suggests a British soldier, but it is the Tommy gun. 'has to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A retriever is a breed of dog used in shooting to fetch game, so a typical example.

clue.text: In Verdun, a war experience renders us insensible

indicators.note: In means the answer lies within the words Verdun, a war experience

explanation.surface: A veteran reflects that fighting at Verdun numbed the men.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs through verdUN A WAR Experience; 'renders us' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Insensible here means not conscious of something, lacking awareness.

clue.text: Character! Exactly what is needed in a person of honour

definitions.meaning: a character is a letter of the alphabet

definitions.text: Exactly what is needed in a person of honour
definitions.meaning: the eighth letter is needed to spell honour, and a person of honour is said to be honest

explanation.surface: Praising someone's integrity as exactly the quality an honourable person needs.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is a joke: the letter is silent in honour, yet the word cannot be spelt without it.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the spelt-out name of the letter H, a written character that the word honour requires at its start.

clue.text: A kind of mass written up in Latin version

indicators.note: in places the up word inside the rearranged Latin
version means a different rendering of the word Latin, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A form of Mass is written up in a Latin translation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'version' rearranges LATIN into NTIAL, and 'in' puts UP inside it after N. 'written' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A wedding Mass is a nuptial Mass, so the adjective names one kind of Mass.

clue.text: Sketch a military detachment

definitions.meaning: a sketch is a rough first version or outline
a detachment of soldiers sent off for special duty

explanation.surface: A comedy sketch about a platoon.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough outline or preliminary version is one sense; a body of troops picked out for a duty is the other.

clue.text: Touchy about one day's evidence

indicators.note: about means the touchy word wraps around one and the day

parts.note: touchy means testy, irritable
one is the Roman numeral I
Mon is short for Monday, a day

explanation.surface: A witness gets irritable about one day's worth of evidence in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts I + MON inside TESTY, after TEST.
explanation.definitionFit: Testimony is a witness's statement in court, evidence given under oath.

clue.text: One who is tender to the kids

definitions.text: One who is tender to the kids

parts.words: One who is tender to the kids
parts.note: tender reads as gentle, but means one who tends, and kids are young goats

explanation.surface: A loving parent or nanny gentle with children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tender' looks like an adjective (gentle) but is a noun, one who tends; the kids are young goats.
explanation.definitionFit: A herdsman who looks after a flock of goats tends their young.

clue.text: Spread bad news about origins of Third Reich

indicators.note: about means the scrambled letters go around the initials
bad means the letters of news are spoiled into a new order
origins of means the first letters of Third and Reich

explanation.surface: Dire news about the rise of the Nazi state circulates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges NEWS into SEWN, and 'about' puts TR inside it after S.
explanation.definitionFit: Strewn means scattered or spread untidily over a surface.
